trust_decision.summary: report_sql::prepare_sql decides whether the URL parameter filter_var is a safe 'AND|OR <field> <op> <value>' clause; at the pinned commit the left side is any text (.*?) and is spliced into the report SQL as raw SQL, only the value is bound.

landing_point.why: The only code that reads filter_var / %%FILTER_VAR%%; the summary names filter_var directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: viewreport.php?id=..&filter_var=.. (view and download) via create_report(); also WS block_configurable_reports get_report_data via classes/external.php:100

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the yearhebrew filter: it is a different filter plugin with its own request parameter (filter_yearhebrew), values come from a fixed select list in the form, and the advisory only names filter_var.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Report authors' legitimate filter_var clauses must keep working: table-alias columns (u.city), a wrapped column (LOWER(username)), quoted values, LIKE/NOT LIKE, IN lists and BETWEEN. A fix that drops filter_var or allows only bare columns breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: column wrapped in one of LOWER/UPPER/TRIM/LENGTH
value containing SQL text (bound as a parameter)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The yearhebrew SQL-report filter concatenates the raw (PARAM_RAW) filter_yearhebrew request value into the same report SQL that prepare_sql passes to execute_query, with no binding.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate filter plugin and separate request parameter, not filter_var; the form offers only a fixed list of years.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and directory (components/filters/yearhebrew) reached through reports/sql/report.class.php:92-99

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a placeholder variant where the operator or field comes from the request rather than from the stored %%FILTER_SEARCHTEXT:field:op%% token
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: searchtext already parses field/operator from a placeholder and whitelists operators, so a maintainer could plausibly add a request-driven operator for flexibility.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second request-driven placeholder (e.g. a sort/ORDER BY variable) handled next to %%FILTER_VAR%%
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: prepare_sql already does free-form placeholder substitution here; an ORDER BY identifier variable is a common report-feature request.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89): request text spliced into a report SQL clause as an identifier/expression

O10_build.toolchain: Moodle 4.x core checkout with this block in blocks/configurable_reports, PHP 8.x, composer, Moodle PHPUnit init (admin/tool/phpunit/cli/init.php)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/courses_filter_test.php, tests/user_filter_test.php, tests/fuserfield_filter_test.php cover filter plugins; nothing at the pinned commit covers %%FILTER_VAR%% (the fix adds tests/sql_filter_var_test.php).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten the existing regex with a keyword blacklist (UNION, --, ;) on the left side, or escape it, instead of whitelisting the left side as a single identifier or one whitelisted function of one.

out_of_scope_notes: components/customsql/form.php:143 discards the params returned by prepare_sql, and :189-190 treats the returned array as SQL; these look like functional bugs, not this protection.
block_configurable_reports.php:223-229 (cron) treats prepare_sql's array return as a string; this is a functional bug.
The calcs and plot components (e.g. components/calcs/component.class.php:94-95) also pass the prepare_sql array straight to execute_query.
